opportunities.name: Tech lead research: HN + GitHub repo -> note
opportunities.description: For a given project name, search Hacker News (HN search/Algolia), find the GitHub repo and its stars/last release, then save a 'Lead:' note with HN title/points/age and GitHub stats.
steps: Search project name on Hacker News (Algolia)
Note top story title, points and age
Read star count and last release date
Open notes app, click New note
Type 'Lead: <project>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Country fact-check: World Bank + BBC -> note
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up a World Bank indicator and a related BBC news article, then save a fact-check note combining them.
steps: Open World Bank data, search country name
Open top relevant article and note headline/age
Add a 'Fact-check <country>' note with the figure and context
